# Heights

> > Heights is a science-backed supplement brand specializing in brain and gut health products, founded by Dan Murray, Joel Freeman, and Sophie Medlin.

Heights offers a curated range of premium supplements including Vitals⁺ (multivitamin), Biotic⁺ (probiotic), Magnesium⁺, Thrive⁺, Calmer⁺, and Hydrate⁺, all formulated with clinically-researched ingredients like Cognizin® and supported by rigorous scientific evidence.

- Biotic⁺

- Brain health

- [Heights Vitals⁺ - Science-Backed Multivitamin for Brain & Body Health](https://www.heights.com/products/vitals): Vitals⁺ multivitamin product page with 20 essential nutrients

- [Heights Magnesium⁺ - Clean Supplement for Deep Sleep & Faster Recovery](https://www.heights.com/products/magnesium): Magnesium⁺ product page for sleep and recovery support
- [Heights' Thrive⁺ – a targeted supplement for healthy ageing](https://www.heights.com/products/thrive): Thrive⁺ supplement with Niagen and CoQ10 for cellular energy
- [Heights Calmer⁺ – A botanical blend for calm and balance](https://www.heights.com/products/calmer): Calmer⁺ botanical supplement with Ashwagandha for stress relief
